improvements: Retained the mapped station/guideway alignment and changed the elevated platform from 15 m to the published approximately 60 ft / 18 m.
Declared only the actual station building w54139654 for replacement; platform and public pedestrian links remain separate source context.
The east footbridge over International Blvd (footway bridge w54139652, outline w469766790) is a glazed walkway inside an open white steel truss with a thin flat roof instead of a closed box.

Its landing is the stair / lift tower w469766788 (dark steel frame, open stair flights, flat roof, glazed lift shaft, one round column), which replaces the generic pitched-roof house previously drawn there; w469766788 is now a declared replacement id.
remainingGaps: Canopy profile, truss sections, concourse height, platform width and approximate west bridge are not newly surveyed.
Exact platform edge/rail alignment and all pedestrian walkable height transitions require integrated game review.
These are isolated front/top/oblique model studies, not matched street-eye Street View/aerial comparisons. They do not establish full-world, night, weather or seasonal parity.

The shared explicit-ID source-replacement implementation is integrated in production (2c73f3d986a4e52d85f5520ca6cb3d4b732f0d13). These studies retain their actual capture-era source and do not establish current district placement, road/body clearance, traffic/mirror budgets or seasonal parity. Registry entries outside a district list and context-only models with no replacement IDs do not replace neighbouring buildings.

Bridge deck and roof heights (8.5 m / 12.6 m), truss panel count, stair tower height (14.6 m), flight geometry and the lift shaft size are estimates; character was checked against street-level imagery as viewed reference only.

checks.label: Model studies recaptured at 346f798
checks.details: Front, top and oblique studies recaptured from the unmodified worktree after the district fidelity pass. The front study uses a 300 m camera distance (d=300) so the new stair tower is inside the frame; the earlier front study stood closer. Headless Chromium (Playwright), ANGLE Direct3D 11 on an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 (hardware GL, audio muted). Earlier collections in this record were rendered with SwiftShader, so small shading and anti-aliasing differences are not scene changes.
